en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard divided into four photographs of historic buildings and cityscapes. The upper left shows a large ornate institutional building along a broad street. The upper right shows a substantial city hall–type structure dominated by a tall clock tower. The lower left image is a riverfront panorama with stone bridge arches and Baroque church and civic buildings along the opposite bank. The lower right image features an elaborate Baroque pavilion with rich sculptural decoration and large windows, with another domed building visible in the distant background.
